On a failed save, the target takes 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and it is blinded until the start of the war priest's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The war priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Spare The Dying|spare the dying]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|flame strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Guardian Of Faith|guardian of faith]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Revivify|revivify]]

bonus_actions.name: Healing Light (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The war priest or one creature of its choice within 60 feet of it regains 12 (2d8 + 3) hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warlock makes two Rapier attacks, or it uses Bewildering Word twice.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Bewildering Word
actions.desc: The warlock utters a magical bewilderment, targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the warlock's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]]

reactions.name: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: In response to taking damage, the warlock turns invisible and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

sb.name: Warlock of the Fiend
sb.languages: any two languages (usually Abyssal or Infernal)

traits.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: When the warlock makes an ability check or saving throw, it can add a d10 to the roll. It can do this after the roll is made but before any of the roll's effects occur.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warlock makes three Scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire
actions.desc: Green flame explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the warlock. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage and 11 (2d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

reactions.name: Fiendish Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: In response to being damaged by a visible creature within 60 feet of it, the warlock forces that creature to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

n: Warlock of the Great Old One
tk: bestiary/tokens/MPMM/Warlock of the Great Old One.webp

sb.name: Warlock of the Great Old One
sb.damage_resistances: psychic

traits.name: Whispering Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of the warlock's turns, each creature of its choice within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage, provided that the warlock isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warlock makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Howling Void
actions.desc: The warlock opens a momentary extraplanar rift within 60 feet of it. The rift is a scream-filled, 20-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened of the warlock until the start of the warlock's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Gate|arcane gate]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/True Seeing|true seeing]]

sb.name: Warlord

traits.name: Indomitable (3/Day)
traits.desc: The warlord can reroll a saving throw it fails. It must use the new roll.

traits.name: Survivor
traits.desc: The warlord regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has fewer than half its hit points but at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warlord makes two Greatsword or Short bow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Command Ally
legendary_actions.desc: The warlord targets one ally it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see and hear the warlord, the target can make one weapon attack as a reaction and gains advantage on the attack roll.

legendary_actions.name: Weapon Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The warlord makes one Greatsword or Shortbow attack.

legendary_actions.name: Frighten Foe (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The warlord targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see and hear it, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of warlord's next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Wastrilith
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The wastrilith can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Corrupt Water
traits.desc: At the start of each of the wastrilith's turns, exposed water within 30 feet of it is befouled. Underwater, this effect lightly obscures the area until a current clears it away. Water in containers remains corrupted until it evaporates. A creature that consumes this foul water or swims in it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the foul water for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of this time, the poisoned creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned until it finishes a long rest. If another demon drinks the foul water as an action, it gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wastrilith makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, and it uses Grasping Spout.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Spout
actions.desc: The wastrilith magically launches a spout of water at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, and it has disadvantage if it's underwater. On a failed save, it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage and is pulled up to 60 feet toward the wastrilith. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

bonus_actions.name: Undertow
bonus_actions.desc: If the wastrilith is underwater, it causes all water within 60 feet of it to be difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn.

sb.name: Water Elemental Myrmidon
sb.damage_resistances: acid; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.languages: Aquan, one language of its creator's choice

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The myrmidon makes three Trident attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Freezing Strikes (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The myrmidon uses Multiattack. Each attack that hits deals an extra 5 (1d10) cold damage. A target that is hit by one or more of these attacks has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

sb.name: White Abishai
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the abishai can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abishai makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one Longsword attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage if used with two hands.

reactions.name: Vicious Reprisal
reactions.desc: In response to taking damage, the abishai makes one Bite attack against a random creature within 5 feet of it. If no creature is within reach, the abishai moves up to half its speed toward an enemy it can see, without provoking opportunity attacks.

sb.name: Winter Eladrin
sb.damage_resistances: cold

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sorrowful Presence
traits.desc: Any non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the eladrin must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws. The charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any eladrin's Sorrowful Presence for the next 24 hours. Whenever the eladrin deals damage to the charmed creature, the charmed creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eladrin makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The eladrin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|gust of wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Sleet Storm|sleet storm]]

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The eladrin teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Frigid Rebuke
reactions.desc: When the eladrin takes damage from a creature the eladrin can see within 60 feet of it, the eladrin can force that creature to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 (2d10) cold damage.

sb.name: Wood Woad
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The wood woad has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The wood woad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in contact with the ground. If the wood woad takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the wood woad's next turn. The wood woad dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, the wood woad can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living tree within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of it that it can see, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wood woad makes two Club attacks.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) force damage.

sb.name: Wretched Sorrowsworn
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Wretched Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The sorrowsworn has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sorrowsworn's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The sorrowsworn otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage, and the sorrowsworn attaches to the target. While attached, the sorrowsworn can't attack, and at the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, the target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage. The attached sorrowsworn moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the sorrowsworn's movement. The sorrowsworn can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the sorrowsworn.

traits.name: Raxivort's Tongue
traits.desc: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 feet of the target, the xvart can push the target 5 feet if the target is a Medium or smaller creature.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Low Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: The xvart takes the Disengage action.

traits.name: Raxivort's Blessing
traits.desc: When the xvart reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, the xvart gains 4 temporary hit points.

traits.name: Raxivort's Tongue
traits.desc: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The xvart makes two Scimitar or Raxivort's Bite attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Raxivort's Bite
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) poison damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The xvart casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|burning hands]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]]

bonus_actions.name: Low Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: The xvart takes the Disengage action.

sb.name: Yagnoloth
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The yagnoloth makes one Electrified Touch attack and one Massive Arm attack, or it makes one Massive Arm attack and uses Battlefield Cunning, if available, or Teleport.

actions.name: Electrified Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Massive Arm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.

actions.name: Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 feet of the yagnoloth that can hear it can use their reactions to make one melee attack each.

actions.name: Life Leech
actions.desc: The yagnoloth touches one incapacitated creature within 15 feet of it. The target takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The yagnoloth teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The yagnoloth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **3/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]

sb.name: Yeenoghu
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Yeenoghu makes three Flail attacks.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) force damage. If it's his turn, Yeenoghu can cause the target to suffer one of the following additional effects, each of which he can apply only once per turn

- **Confusion.** The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the confusion spell until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
- **Force.** The target takes an extra 13 (2d12) force damage.
- **Paralysis.** The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Yeenoghu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]]

bonus_actions.name: Rampage
bonus_actions.desc: When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, he moves up to half his speed and makes one Bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Charge
legendary_actions.desc: Yeenoghu moves up to his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Swat Away
legendary_actions.desc: Yeenoghu makes one Flail attack. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet in a straight line away from Yeenoghu. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Savage (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Yeenoghu makes a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 feet of him.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Yeth Hound
sb.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
sb.languages: understands Common, Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Sunlight Banishment
traits.desc: If the yeth hound starts its turn in sunlight, it is transported to the Ethereal Plane. While sunlight shines on the spot from which it vanished, the hound must remain in the Deep Ethereal. After sunset, it returns to the Border Ethereal at the same spot, whereupon it typically sets out to find its pack or its master. The hound is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane. Once it is adjacent to its master or a pack mate that is on the Material Plane, a yeth hound in the Border Ethereal can return to the Material Plane as an action.

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.desc: While the yeth hound is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage if the target is frightened.

actions.name: Baleful Baying
actions.desc: The yeth hound bays magically. Every enemy within 300 feet of the hound that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the hound until the end of the hound's next turn or until the hound is incapacitated. A frightened target that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hound must use all its movement on that turn to get as far from the hound as possible, must finish the move before taking an action, and must take the most direct route, even if hazards lie that way. A target that successfully saves is immune to the baying of all yeth hounds for the next 24 hours.

sb.name: Young Kruthik
sb.senses: darkvision 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2½-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Stab
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

sb.name: Yuan-ti Anathema
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The anathema has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Ophidiophobia Aura
traits.desc: Any creature of the anathema's choice, other than a snake or a yuan-ti, that starts its turn within 30 feet of the anathema must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of snakes and yuan-ti. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this anathema's aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Six Heads
traits.desc: The anathema has advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack (Anathema Form Only)
actions.desc: The anathema makes two Claw attacks and one Flurry of Bites attack.

actions.name: Claw (Anathema Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flurry of Bites (Anathema Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict (Snake Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and it takes 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The anathema can constrict only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Anathema Form Only)
actions.desc:
The anathema casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Friendship|animal friendship]] (snakes only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zaratan makes one Bite attack and one Stomp attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) thunder damage.

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, range 120 ft./240 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Spew Debris (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The zaratan exhales rocky debris in a 90-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is knocked prone.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.desc: After moving at least 10 feet on the ground, the zaratan sends a shock wave through the ground in a 120-foot-radius circle centered on itself. That area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature on the ground that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or the creature's concentration is broken. The shock wave deals 100 thunder damage to all structures in contact with the ground in the area. If a creature is near a structure that collapses, the creature might be buried; a creature within half the distance of the structure's height must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone, and is trapped in the rubble. A trapped creature is restrained, requiring a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to escape. Another creature within 5 feet of the buried creature can use its action to clear rubble and grant advantage on the check. If three creatures use their actions in this way, the check is an automatic success. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone or become trapped.

legendary_actions.name: Stomp
legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan makes one Stomp attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan makes one Spit Rock attack.

legendary_actions.name: Retract (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan retracts into its shell. Until it takes its Emerge action, it has resistance to all damage, and it is restrained. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Revitalize or Emerge action.

legendary_actions.name: Revitalize (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell. It regains 52 (5d20) hit points. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Emerge action.

legendary_actions.name: Emerge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The zaratan emerges from its shell and makes one Spit Rock attack. It can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell.

bonus_actions.name: Infestation Spores (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Zuggtmoy releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on her, and it lingers for 1 minute. Any creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy, which lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be.

bonus_actions.name: Mind Control Spores (Recharge 5–6)

Humanoids and Beasts in the cloud when it appears, or that enter it later, must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, a creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the influence of Zuggtmoy for 24 hours. While infected in this way, the creature is charmed by her and can't be reinfected by these spores.
